comparison.objective: Pour a simulated molten charge into the dry rather than wet mould.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually lift and tip a crucible shank while selecting the safe mould and controlling spill.
comparison.success_condition: At least 90% enters dry mould with at most three spilled beads; crucible returned upright and released for 1 s. Any charge in wet mould or direct crucible grasp fails.
comparison.reason: Its free beads and containment concern arise from pouring, not from producing and recovering fragments through controlled notch fracture.
